_tuning_notes: Taiga grizzly, the diet-system showcase. diet.hunts = entity ids fished/hunted when hungry (paw-swipe at salmon in water within 12, 40% per swipe, hardcoded); diet.scavenges reserved for shared use with the vulture. special.berry_raiding also needs mobGriefing. Mother-aggro: hurting a cub or standing within 6 blocks of one angers every adult within 16. Sleeps at night in shelter — day is the threat window. Phase 3: salmon (diet) baits cage traps; needs the reinforced tier. RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-3, cap 3). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever.
guide_blurb: Fish thief, berry burglar, terrible alarm clock.
